scope_details: All NFL Week 9 regular-season games scheduled Sunday, November 8, 2026; excludes Thursday November 5 and Monday November 9.
scheduled_games: Cleveland Browns at New Orleans Saints
New York Jets at Kansas City Chiefs
New York Giants at Philadelphia Eagles
Los Angeles Rams at Washington Commanders
Houston Texans at Los Angeles Chargers
Las Vegas Raiders at San Francisco 49ers
Green Bay Packers at New England Patriots
Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Chicago Bears

historical_sample.label: L10
historical_sample.definition: 10 most recent qualifying completed regular-season games before the locked historical cutoff.

historical_cutoff.rule: Completion of the final scheduled game of Week 8

methodology_overrides: Use the 20-game 25th percentile (P25) instead of the 16th percentile measure.
P25 is calculated independently of the locked L10 sample.

percentile_statistics.p25: 20-game 25th percentile using standard linear interpolation; 20 most recent qualifying completed regular-season games before the locked cutoff.

source_snapshot.note: FanDuel main-market lines were present for every normalized player-market combination found in the DraftKings main-market data; no DraftKings fallback was needed.

screening_summary.qualification_rule: Current Market HR >= 6/10 OR at least one applicable fixed ladder threshold >= 8/10.
